title: Keyboard-first Compact Metrics: Perceptual Color Ramps & Locale-Ready Row Density
creator: Avery Kim
description: Design and prototype a compact metrics table mode for the Redwood Console dashboards that is keyboard-first, uses perceptually-uniform color ramps suitable for common color-vision deficiencies, and supports locale-aware number density and truncation rules. This ticket covers the prototype, WCAG contrast pass, localization readiness checklist, and developer handoff artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: Compact mode implements 2 density levels (condensed, compact) with consistent keyboard focus order across devices
Color ramp passes simulated deuteranopia/protanopia/tritanopia checks and maintains 4.5:1 contrast ratio for foreground text against background surfaces per WCAG AA
Numeric formats honor user locale and compactness settings (e.g., 1.2K vs 1.2 K depending on locale) and do not truncate meaningful precision for billing-related metrics
Figma prototype annotated with focus ring states, announceable live region text for screen readers, and ARIA guidance for devs
Design tokens for new color ramp and density spacing added to token catalog with responsive rules
decisions: Use perceptual Lab (LCH) derived ramp as base; provide tokenized semantic names: semantic-primary-1..6
Default to compact density on small screens and allow user override in dashboard settings
Keyboard row focus moves left-to-right, top-to-bottom; context menu invoked with Shift+F10 fallback
Truncation policy: preserve 3 significant digits for billing metrics and annotate with tooltip showing full value
